purpose: Priorizar la incorporación técnica de colecciones textuales ya curadas por proyectos externos. Este catálogo no equivale a admisión: cada documento debe conservar su procedencia y superar los filtros definidos.

global_admission_policy.conditional_rule: Admitir solo cuando la licencia del documento y las obligaciones de atribución/compartir-igual estén preservadas y sean compatibles con el uso previsto. No inferir derechos de los términos de la colección.
global_admission_policy.training_rule: Los catálogos, fichas, metadatos y registros sintéticos no se cuentan como documentos de texto entrenables. No importar benchmarks ni splits de evaluación.

sources.revision_policy: Pin exact Hugging Face commit before acquisition
sources.notes: La colección es enorme y multilingüe; seleccionar primero español y dominios con alta utilidad. La ficha general no sustituye la licencia individual.

sources.revision_policy: Pin collection item revisions and each source dataset revision
sources.notes: Preferir la versión filtrada/deduplicada, pero auditar por componente: que el corpus agregado sea abierto no convierte todas las licencias en una licencia única.

sources.revision_policy: Pin exact Git commit; resolve every linked collection independently
curation: catalog of academic and public-domain corpora
allow_only: per-item public domain or explicit open license
exclude: catalog entries without retrievable full text
sources.notes: No copiar el catálogo como si fuera corpus; usarlo para descubrir fuentes académicas y volver a la licencia del editor de cada obra.

sources.revision_policy: Pin API/export snapshot and preserve record identifiers
allow_only: CC-BY-4.0 records with explicit item-level evidence
sources.notes: Preserve attribution to BNE and individual author/editor metadata. Do not assume every digitized work shares the catalog-level license.

sources.revision_policy: Pin exact release/commit and license file
exclude: third-party figures or appendices unless separately licensed
sources.notes: High value for the reasoning library; preserve chapter structure and theorem/proof boundaries.

sources.revision_policy: Pin dump date and entity revision IDs
exclude: claims without references where factual QA is generated
sources.notes: Convert triples into literal factual statements only with qualifiers, references and entity IDs preserved; do not present a bare triple as verified explanation.

sources.revision_policy: Use the already pinned release asset and SHA-256 in MINIRONIN
curation: 147 works selected for science and logic
exclude: duplicate editions and package metadata counted as works
sources.notes: Already represented by the persistent MINIRONIN release; reuse the existing verified asset rather than download a duplicate.

execution_order: 1. Open and pin PleIAs Common Corpus; build a Spanish-only document inventory before downloading payloads.
2. Open and pin Common Pile filtered collections; select source components by explicit license evidence and remove overlap with MINIRONIN.
3. Expand BNE CC BY 4.0 records in deterministic non-overlapping batches.
4. Add Open Logic Project as a structured reasoning-library intake after checking exact release terms.
5. Use OpenCorpus as a discovery index for additional TEI/CoNLL-U collections; resolve rights at each upstream source.
6. Add Wikidata CC0 statements only as a separately labelled factual/semantic library with references and qualifiers.
